newsitem.title: INDIA: India castor prices rise after recent falls.
newsitem.headline: India castor prices rise after recent falls.

text.p: Indian castorseed September delivery prices on Friday rose to 1,140/1,141 rupees from 1,137/1,138 rupees as light short-covering helped prices to bounce back after recent losses, dealers said.
"Technically the market was oversold and we were expecting short-covering which emerged today," a dealer said.
"Trading volumes however remained slow and undercurrent still remained subdued amid absence of fresh overseas enquiries," he said.
Arrivals of castorseed in the Gujarat region fell to 22,000/23,000 bags (75 kg each) from 25,000/27,000 bags reported on Thursday.
Groundnut oil eased to 358/359 rupees per 10 kg from 361/362 rupees as demand resistance prompted light profit-taking but inflows were restricted to 40/50 tonnes.
Imported palm oil was steady at 277/278 rupees per 10 kg. In Rajkot spot groundnut oil was steady at 560/565 rupees per 15 kg. -- Bombay Commodities +91-22-265 9000
